messages:
pagerduty-bot: INCIDENT detected: API Gateway 5xx spike > 4% over 5m for prod. Paging on-call. (alert: gateway_5xx_rate)

jamal: on it. noticing error distribution looks concentrated on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. 503s + upstream timeouts from provider-cdn.

alex: confirming, logs show a surge of 502/504 from upstream-cdn-1 - connection resets, TLS handshake failures. adding correlation with increased p95 latency to the gateway.

sarah: @jamal do we have a quick mitigation path? can we failover traffic or throttle retries from the gateway?

jamal: yes — rolling a temporary routing change to push traffic off upstream-cdn-1 -> upstream-cdn-2 for the matching host header. doing a canary 10% now.

ops-bot: deploy job started: route-change/cdn-failover canary=10% by jamal

alex: adding header-based routing is in flight. if canary looks clean we'll ramp to 100% in 5m. watching 5xx rate and qps.

dave: /cc prod-sig: customer-facing endpoints under the ML ingestion pipeline may see degraded throughput. notifying success and acct teams if this stretches beyond 30m.

jamal: can we mute the noisy 5xx alert while the remediation is in progress? otherwise it keeps paging the next oncall.

sarah: +1 mute it for 30m. set alert suppression in Alertmanager and create a short-lived silence referencing the inc number.

alex: created silence: alertmanager.silences/SM-8245 (30m) — note: keeping a manual watch and alerting via this thread. also bumped the alert severity to P2 in the incident tracker.

jamal: can we avoid the flapping by modifying the Prometheus rule afterwards? current rule is:  sum(rate(gateway_responses{code=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(gateway_responses[5m])) > 0.01  (1%). I'm going to propose changing to a 10m window and 1.5% threshold for global alerting, and add per-route thresholds for high-traffic endpoints.

sarah: agree on longer window. also we should add a check that looks at upstream error ratio (gateway->upstream) so we don't alert for transient client spikes. propose new rule text:

```
expr: (sum(rate(gateway_responses{code=~"5.."}[10m])) by (job) / sum(rate(gateway_responses[10m])) by (job)) > 0.015
for: 5m
labels: { severity="warning" }
annotations: { summary="Gateway 5xx rate >1.5% over 10m" }
```

jamal: that looks good. also adding a companion alert for upstream_provider_5xx_ratio where upstream errors > 2% and we trigger a different runbook (upstream contact & routing failover) so it's not mixed with gateway internal errors.

dave: +1. can someone spin up a Grafana panel that shows: overall 5xx rate, per-route 5xx, upstream provider error ratio, and TLS handshake failure count? that'll help during future triage.

alex: making a quick dashboard now under team/eng-sre -> panel: 'Gateway - 5xx & upstream health'. I'll add an embedded link here when done.

jamal: canary looks clean at 10%. ramping to 100% now. monitoring closely.

ops-bot: deploy job finished: route-change/cdn-failover success canary=100% by jamal

alex: 5xx rate is trending down to baseline ~0.3%. p95 latency improved.

sarah: starting a short post-incident tasks list — please confirm owners:
- update prometheus rule: jamal
- create alert runbook for upstream_provider_5xx_ratio: dave
- add grafana dashboard & alert panels: alex
- update incident playbook with CDN failover steps and communicator templates: sarah

jamal: taking prometheus rule. I'll open a PR with the new expr and a note about rationale + backout plan.

dave: taking runbook. will include escalation matrix to the provider, required logs, and a snippet to trigger immediate route failover.

alex: dashboard done: https://grafana.internal/r/ENGSRE/gateway-5xx-upstream — added panels + a small alert rule that maps to upstream_provider_5xx_ratio (temp) so SRE can triage before we bake into prod alerts.

sarah: handoff incoming — @jamal I'm going offline in 15m to pick up a paging rotation. jamal, can you own the watch until the postmortem? I'll be on-call next shift but want the initial RCA and the runbook updates completed.

jamal: I got it. will finish prometheus PR, postmortem draft, and link runbook updates here. I'll also remove the temporary silence once alerts are adjusted.

pagerduty-bot: Incident SM-8245 resolved: gateway 5xx rate returned to normal. Duration: 32m. On-call: jamal

sarah: thank you all. quick retrospective note: we need better upstream health telemetry (TLS handshake metrics + connection reset counts) surfaced on the main dashboard. add to backlog: infra-metrics-team.

jamal: noted. filing ticket: INFRA-2093: surfacing upstream TLS & conn-reset metrics to gateway dashboard.

alex: leaving thumbsup :thumbsup: — nice quick failover and clear alert changes. will follow up on dashboard improvements.

sarah: closing thread — keep updates in the postmortem doc. we'll review alert thresholds in next week's SRE sync.
